messages:
alex: PTAL — pushed a follow-up that addresses the comments from yesterday. Small refactor in retry.go and bumped the default client backoff from 100ms -> 200ms. Added unit + a quick integration smoke. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234
marie: quick q — does the backoff change affect kv-cache eviction or our eviction jitter? we sometimes rely on retries for transient failures
alex: short answer: no. backoff only applies to the artifact upload client (comments added in retry.go). kv eviction uses a separate lease/jitter path. i left an inline comment explaining the separation.
marie: ok thanks, just wanted to be sure.
sam: can you paste the staging loadtest numbers? if retries change we should check tail latency
alex: ran a quick run on staging: 200 RPS, 1k seq. results below. p99 moved 85ms -> 88ms, error rate slightly down. logs: ```loadtest summary
requests: 10000
p50: 22ms
p95: 60ms
p99: 88ms
errors: 3 (0.03%)```
marie: that looks fine to me. PTAL from me :thumbsup:
sam: lgtm, left one tiny changelog nit (please add a 1-line entry) :+1:
alex: will add changelog entry in the merge commit. any preference on squash? i kept commits separate for review clarity
marie: no need to squash from my side
sam: no squash needed, merge when ready
alex: planning to merge and schedule canary at 23:00 PT if no objections. pinging @eng-canary and deploy-bot for slot
deploy-bot: Canaries reserved at 23:00 PT (us-west-2) for PR #1234 (requested by alex).
alex: thanks — merging in ~10m unless any last concerns
marie: none
sam: all good
alex: merged and started canary; will monitor logs and post an update in ~15m
